chunks_table_definition:
CREATE TABLE `chunks` (
  `chunk_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `article_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `chunk_index` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `section_title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `text` text NOT NULL,
  `char_count` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `embedding` vector(384) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`chunk_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_chunks_article_idx` (`article_id`,`chunk_index`),
  VECTOR KEY `embedding` (`embedding`) `M`='16' `DISTANCE`='cosine',
  CONSTRAINT `fk_chunks_article` FOREIGN KEY (`article_id`) REFERENCES `articles` (`article_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=8744 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci

search_strategies.hybrid: Exact cosine ranking with relational SQL filters

timing_methodology: Retriever latency measured with perf_counter; one warm-up request per query and mode; P50/P95 computed across per-query means of measured repetitions.
